", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0082", "tag": "p", "text": "“Francis, I’m glad for one thing, most damn glad....”", "sha256": "09d86c337c2af559e35d82b994cb365763eb290173bb46b41641c6bc199eadd8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[566]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0083", "tag": "p", "text": "“Which is?” Francis queried in the pause, just as they swung around the corner to the horses.", "sha256": "61c1fac55f4626f02f02f23b4ed0eeb3786377a85ff55d2efe64dabeb094fba5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[567]", "source_html": "
